The reported 97.9% measures benzene taken up from a 50/50 mixture, rather than product purity or energy saved. Larger-scale use is a participating researcher’s account. Whole-process economics, sustained performance and net energy savings remain open; heating is needed for reuse. The source review inspected public abstract and institutional reporting, not subscription full text or an operating plant.
